evidence: The growth and chemical composition of the grown films were analyzed by various analysis techniques including Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (TEM). In addition, the thermal annealing of PE-ALD Ta films on Si and SiO substrates was performed to study the thermal stability of the deposited Ta films. The impurity content and thickness of the films were determined by RBS and the H concentration of the films were determined by forward recoil elastic spectrometry (FRES). The sheet resistance was measured by four-point probe and the microstructures were analyzed using XRD, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and TEM.
